record.question: The open loop transfer function of a feedback control system is G(S)*H(S) = 1/(S(S + 1)^3), the gain margin of the system is
record.explanation: Printed page 2 gives G(s)H(s) = 1/(s+1)^3, without the extra factor s in the packet. For the printed formula, phase crossover satisfies 3 arctan(omega) = 180 degrees, so omega = sqrt(3), magnitude = (1+3)^(-3/2) = 1/8, and gain margin = 8. Confidence is low because the packet formula 1/[s(s+1)^3] instead gives gain margin 8/9, which is absent from the options.
